basis: Public-domain French author text in the Analysis Situs project transcription of Œuvres, volume VI. Newly rendered into English; not copied from Stillwell. Modern website notes excluded; §§II and IX author footnotes retained. Not collated line by line with journal printing.

originalPublication.journal: Rendiconti del Circolo Matematico di Palermo

correctionsAndQualifications: Publication date distinguished from centenary-volume label.
Extraneous zero after the equal contour squares removed.
Surface-boundary/null-homotopy inference retained as a claim and refuted in the margin.
Repeated defining-function subscripts corrected.
Simple connectivity versus ball/sphere links explicitly distinguished.
Two intermediate-face dimensions and the cross factor in the simplex sign array corrected.
The author footnote’s n-1 hyperplanes is rendered n+1 with disclosure.
Boundary sum restores lambda coefficients and lower-cell j index.
Boundary generator uses degree q+1, not q-1.
Rank inequality compares alpha-prime with alpha-double-prime.
Initial alpha-prime-zero restored to one.
External top chain separated from homology of the original manifold.
Old boundary relation and seven-index zeta notation normalized.
Compatibility identity has matching face and subdivision indices.
Grouped sums assigned A,d,G; the dimension-reversed congruence is written as a boundary equation.
Malformed local array replaced by the stated three incidences +1,-1,0.
Coefficient difference corrected to alpha1-alpha2.
Ball acyclicity and finite compatible refinement stated as requirements.
Dimensions in face-intersection paragraph restored.
New cap K-prime bounded by C-prime, not C.
Local strip and chamber-boundary filling require general position and ball/sphere hypotheses.
Face and edge point dimensions restored.
Dual vertices are old chamber points.
Dual incidence arrays replaced by reverse-degree signed transposes.
Cyclic chamber list ends at q, not p.
Reverse path comparison uses distinct entry and exit faces and consistent connector indices.
Upper-right block uses chamber-to-face incidence of degree three.
Example has three bottom rows, matching the announced three edges.
Homology column sort and incidence degree corrected.
Nonzero column and pure-face congruence counts restore missing primes.
Nonzero rational scaling stipulated for denominator clearing.
Repeated closedness display replaced by the intended vanishing intersection assertion.
Incidence indices corrected in coefficient relation.
Minor criterion stated by square size and maximal rank instead of conflicting deletion indices.
Integer versus geometric boundary comparison kept explicit.
Last endpoint in relation (2) restored to a_h.
Face-boundary coefficients are degree two.
A homology sign restored where a congruence was printed.
Last sign in the second Euler count restored to plus.
Truncated region is p-dimensional, not p-1-dimensional.
Complementary-face dimension retains its final minus one.
Finite chart partition, tame intersections, and radial stratification recorded as unproved prerequisites.

englishComparison.use: Credits and extent inspected; linked for comparison, not reproduced.

archiveAccess: Original Nantes PDF returned HTTP 403 during preparation; transcription is the declared basis.
notation: Repeated grouped sums use compact named chains, cyclic lists use indexed notation, dual incidence arrays use reverse-degree signed transposes. All argument stages and eleven sections are retained.
